name: Tech Energy America LLC
old_description: Tech Energy America is a wholesale electrical distributor in Scottsdale, AZ — transformers, wire & cable, and UL-listed switchgear for contractors and industrial, since 2009.
about:
Tech Energy America LLC operates from Scottsdale, Arizona, where it was founded in 2009. The company began when contractors and industrial buyers in the region struggled to obtain straight pricing and reliable delivery from large national distributors, prompting the founders to build a wholesale supply house focused on transparency and speed.

The business runs two complementary lines: wholesale distribution of transformers, wire and cable, conduit, breakers, panelboards, and related electrical materials, plus in-house manufacturing of UL-listed switchgear, panelboards, and VFDs at its Scottsdale facility. As Arizona representative for JST Power, CME Wire, Priority Wire, and Southwire — and authorized source for Square D/Schneider Electric, Allied Tube, and Cantex — it stocks pad-mount transformers (12.47/34.5 kV, 500–3,500 kVA), PV wire, XHHW-2, and EV charging equipment, shipping nationwide via freight.

Customers include licensed electrical contractors, solar EPCs and builders such as Solar Gain Inc., industrial buyers, and resellers across Arizona’s major metros — Scottsdale, Phoenix, Mesa, Tempe, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Peoria, and Tucson — with statewide delivery on request and wholesale freight nationwide. The firm supplies materials only; installation is handled by sister company ConstruTech Group.

The company emphasizes three commitments: a fully bilingual English/Spanish team from ownership through order logistics, same-day RFQ turnaround on most bills of materials, and documentation by default including spec sheets and manufacturer warranty paperwork. In-house switchgear assembly cuts typical lead times to 4–8 weeks for standard 480V/600V assemblies, versus 16–26 weeks from out-of-state OEMs.
